unique_remaining_use_cases: Check whether a caller-selected execution receipt is byte-bound, unexpired, and exactly scoped to a later task before exposing it as an optional reference; preserve a negative execution as a counterexample and require review for transfer.

comparators.exact_task_finding: Its preserved PR264 receipt output reports EFFECT_PRESENT, findings=[], but outcome_truth=NOT_ESTABLISHED and source_authentication=NOT_PERFORMED. It checks an individual receipt; it does not compare the run scope with a later task.
Its object is a derived context card with source/version/access/expiry bindings; it does not consume an execution receipt or preserve failed execution as a counterexample.
It evaluates a proposed recovery after a failure, not whether an earlier experience can be referenced in a later task.

findings: The candidate binds the exact local receipt artifact bytes, checks the receipt structure and caller-declared task/environment/source-scope identity, and withholds expired records before reading their evidence bytes.

A declared EFFECT_PRESENT can produce only OPTIONAL_REFERENCE_ONLY; a preserved EFFECT_ABSENT is COUNTEREXAMPLE_ONLY; mismatched task scope requires review. No outcome truth, actual tool quality, causal effect, or transferable skill is inferred.
The existing effect-receipt and reusable-context tools cover distinct adjacent checks and remain available. This evidence does not justify replacing or retiring either.
Comparison remains COMPARISON_UNKNOWN: no matched task-completion, cost, reliability, or maintenance trial estimates portfolio-wide benefit.
negative_controls: expired receipt withheld before file read
negative outcome without preserved failure requires review
execution_authorized=false and reuse_authorized=false in all results
claim_ceiling: One exact local PR264 receipt replay and focused negative controls show byte-bound, scope-sensitive optional-reference filtering. This is not evidence of source/run authenticity, true task success, broad skill-transfer performance, or portfolio-wide net benefit.
